Indikator 4y measures performance across different geographical levels in Denmark, comparing national and regional results against a specific development target. Based on the 2024 data, the national average for Indikator 4y stands at 82.6% [^src1].

When examining regional performance, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] emerges as the leader with the highest score of 84.6% [^src1]. In contrast, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] trails as the lowest-performing region in this dataset, recording a result of 77.2% [^src1]. 

Despite the regional variation, neither the national average nor the individual regions meet the established development target. The stated goal for this indicator is ≥ 90%, meaning that both the leading region (84.6%) and the trailing region (77.2%) fall short of the required threshold [^src1]. Because the available evidence consists of only a single dated section from 2024, it is not possible to identify any historical trends, improvements, or declines over time for these regions.

## Table: AKDB_2024.pdf, p. 26

Rows compare: geografisk niveau · Columns show: præstationsmål og resultater

| Geografisk niveau | Andel (%) | 95 % CI |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Danmark | 82,6 | 80,6–84,4 |
| Region Sjælland | 84,6 | 79,8–88,6 |
| Region Nordjylland | 77,2 | 68,4–84,5 |

Entities: indikator-4y, region-sjaelland, region-nordjylland

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner national og regional præstation for Indikator 4y og viser en regional variation fra 77,2 % i Region Nordjylland til 84,6 % i Region Sjælland, begge under udviklingsmålet på ≥ 90 %.
